uncoveredRules.name: User Deletion Requires Admin
uncoveredRules.description: Only users with the admin role can delete other user accounts.
uncoveredRules.validation:
Current user must have role = 'admin'.
Admin cannot delete their own account.
tests: non-admin attempting user deletion returns 403
admin can delete other users successfully
admin cannot delete their own account

uncoveredRules.name: Active Subscription Required
uncoveredRules.description: Certain features require the user to have an active or trialing subscription.
uncoveredRules.validation:
Subscription status must be 'active' or 'trialing'.
Cancelled, expired, and past_due subscriptions do not qualify.
tests: usage endpoint returns 402 when subscription is cancelled
usage endpoint returns 402 when subscription is expired
usage endpoint succeeds when subscription is active
usage endpoint succeeds when subscription is trialing

uncoveredRules.name: Seat Limit Per Plan
uncoveredRules.description: The number of seats in a subscription cannot exceed the plan's defined seat limit.
uncoveredRules.validation: seats.active.count < plan.seat_limit must be true before adding a seat.
tests: adding a seat at limit returns 422 with upgrade URL
adding a seat below limit succeeds
seat count in response meta is accurate

uncoveredRules.name: Invoice Payment Window (30 Days)
uncoveredRules.description: Invoices must be paid within 30 days of their due date. Overdue invoices cannot be paid via the standard endpoint.
uncoveredRules.validation:
invoice.due_date must be >= Time.current (not overdue).
invoice.status must not be 'paid'.

body.error: Invoice is overdue and cannot be paid through this endpoint

tests: paying an overdue invoice returns 422
paying an already-paid invoice returns 422
paying a valid pending invoice within window succeeds

uncoveredRules.name: Coupon Single Use Per Account
uncoveredRules.description: Coupons marked as single_use can only be applied once per user account.
uncoveredRules.validation:
If coupon.single_use? is true:
  coupon.redemptions.where(user_id: current_user.id).exists? must be false

body.error: Coupon has already been used by this account

tests: single-use coupon returns 422 on second use by same user
single-use coupon can be used by a different user
non-single-use coupon can be used multiple times

uncoveredRules.name: Subscription Cancellation Period
uncoveredRules.description:
When a user cancels via POST /cancel, the subscription remains active until the
end of the current billing period. Immediate cancellation is only available via DELETE.
uncoveredRules.validation:
POST /cancel: sets cancel_at_period_end = true, does not immediately change status.
DELETE: immediately sets status = 'cancelled'.
tests: POST cancel sets cancel_at_period_end to true
POST cancel returns the period_end date in the response
POST cancel does not immediately change subscription status
DELETE immediately cancels subscription

uncoveredRules.name: Usage Quota Enforcement
uncoveredRules.description: Usage events cannot be recorded if they would exceed the plan's usage quota for the current billing period.
tests: recording usage that would exceed quota returns 422 with quota info
recording usage within quota succeeds
quota enforcement is per billing period, not cumulative

uncoveredRules.name: Subscription Downgrade Adjusts Seats
uncoveredRules.description:
When downgrading to a plan with a lower seat limit, if the current seat count
exceeds the new plan's limit, the oldest seats are automatically deactivated.
uncoveredRules.validation:
If new_plan.seat_limit < current_seat_count:
  Automatically deactivate (current_seat_count - new_plan.seat_limit) oldest seats.
tests: downgrade with excess seats auto-removes oldest seats
downgrade without excess seats does not remove seats
upgrade does not remove any seats

and creates their first subscription (potentially with a free trial).

validates: trial_end_date set to 14 days from now

An existing subscriber upgrades from Starter to Professional plan.

preconditions: User has an active subscription on Starter plan

Browse available plans to find upgrade target

flow.description:
A user decides to cancel their subscription. The cancellation is scheduled
for end of billing period. The subscription remains active until then.
